scientific_hypothesis: A small amount of target-context supervision can repair high-score tail selection in T-cell: fine-tuning the frozen Sample CNN on grouped target-context sequences with joint MSE and dynamic-top16 pairwise logistic loss reduces equal-budget cap16 regret relative to the original CNN.
evidence_boundary: Target-context retrospective grouped holdout only. Target r1/r2 labels are explicitly used in train/dev. Historical outer results were previously inspected. This is not an independent study, sequence-external validation, new blind test, or prospective confirmation.

split.eligibility: Exact 50nt ACGT sequence shared by r1 and r2. Build undirected exact/H1 connected components over all common sequences before any target label is read. r1/r2 shared sequences are therefore always in the same role.
split.component_order: SHA256('tcell_target_adaptation_v1|component|'+SHA256 concatenation of hash-sorted member sequence strings), with component minimum sequence as deterministic tie key.
split.test_sample_exclusion: A component is test-ineligible if any member has exact/H1 match to any Sample train/dev/calibration utr50. The whole component is excluded from test, preventing pretraining exact/H1 leakage into the adapted-versus-original comparison.
split.allocation: Allocate test first from Sample-clean components, then dev, then train, in frozen component order. At each role, skip a component if it exceeds the remaining exact budget and continue until the budget is filled exactly. Fail if exhausted. Unallocated sequences remain unused.
split.nested_rule: Within the frozen 50k train role, order whole components by SHA256('tcell_target_adaptation_v1|nested|'+component_id), take each exact budget with the same skip-if-too-large rule, and verify 1k subset 5k subset 20k subset 50k.
split.pool_rule: Within each role/budget, sort sequences by SHA256('tcell_target_adaptation_v1|pools|role|budget|sequence'); consecutive blocks of 64. Training/dev MSE uses the final partial pool; pairwise and dev selection use complete pools only. Test has exactly 16 complete pools.
split.adjustment_rule: Budgets are primary and may be changed only if exact allocation is impossible; any adjustment must be frozen before target label training. No adjustment is permitted after dev/test results.
split.label_rule: After SPLIT_FROZEN.json is written, read r1/r2 MRL only for train/dev. Fit labels are the arithmetic mean (r1+r2)/2. Test MRL remains unread until the one final evaluation.

model.baseline: Frozen original three-member Sample CNN arithmetic mean in measured-MRL units.
model.initialization: Main, MSE-only and nested runs for seeds 11/23/37 start from the corresponding frozen original member model_state. From-scratch uses the same architecture with ordinary seeded random initialization.
model.parallelism: Three real CUDA seed processes in parallel; no silent CPU fallback.
model.target_scaling: For each train budget independently, standardize mean-replicate MRL with that budget's train-only mean and population SD. Apply the same scaler to dev. Deployed scores are raw network outputs; only order matters.
model.objective: Mean-pool MSE plus lambda times mean-complete-pool dynamic-top16 pairwise logistic loss. All 120 unordered pairs per complete pool, softplus(-sign(y_i-y_j)*(p_i-p_j)); exact label ties have zero weight. Top16 membership uses detached current predictions; score gradients flow through pairs.
model.convergence: DualPlateau on full train and dev combined objective: min_delta=0.0001, patience=5; any absolute dev best resets plateau. No maximum epoch.
model.best_epoch: Absolute best dev combined objective. Save full history, checkpoint and model/hash identity at every best epoch.

selection.proposal_rule: Python random.Random('tcell_target_adaptation_v1|role|pool_index|seed'), floor(random()*64) for 16 nested draws with replacement.
selection.dev_metric: For each variant/hyperparameter candidate, average the three seed best-checkpoint scores on dev and minimize mean cap16 regret using mean-replicate dev MRL, all complete dev pools and five shared nested proposal seeds.
selection.tie_rule: Ties within 1e-12 use lower mean dev combined objective at best epochs, then lower LR, then lower lambda.
selection.main: Select lambda and LR jointly from the full 3x3 grid using train/dev only.
selection.mse_only: Fine-tuned lambda=0 ablation; select LR from the same grid using train/dev only.
selection.from_scratch: From-scratch joint-loss ablation; select lambda and LR independently from the same full grid using train/dev only.
selection.nested: Use only the selected 50k main lambda/LR; train 1k/5k/20k nested budgets without new hyperparameter selection. Learning curves are secondary.
selection.test_freeze: All main, ablation and nested runs, selections, hashes and configuration must be complete before target test inference or MRL reading. No test-driven model, budget, lambda, LR or protocol changes.

evaluation.regret: Full 64-sequence test-pool maximum measured repeat-specific MRL minus selected repeat-specific MRL.
evaluation.random: Random(N) selects the first position of the exact same nested proposal prefix used by every scored method; cap1 methods coincide.
evaluation.effect_sign: Adapted-method regret minus original-CNN regret; negative is improvement.
evaluation.primary: Main-50k ensemble versus original CNN at cap16 in r1 and r2.
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: 16 repeat-linked pools; both repeats and all five proposal seeds move together. Percentile 95% CI.
success: Both repeat-specific cap16 main-minus-original mean regret effects are strictly negative.
Combined repeat-linked block bootstrap 95% CI upper bound is strictly below zero.
Combined absolute reduction is at least max(0.1 MRL, 5% of combined original-CNN cap16 regret).
All split isolation, finite loss, real CUDA, natural convergence, hash and one-evaluation checks pass.
evaluation.holm_family: Ten repeat-specific main-minus-original effects: both repeats at all caps 1/2/4/8/16. Two-sided sign-style pool-bootstrap p-values with Holm step-down and monotonicity enforcement.
evaluation.secondary: Report all caps for main and both 50k ablations, Random(N), cap16 nested learning curve, top-tail flips, selection turnover, pointwise MAE/RMSE/bias/Spearman, and whether error and regret changes move together.

verification_rounds: Round 1 raw/input hashes, label-blind split, exact/H1 component and Sample-clean test isolation, nested subsets, focused tests and real CUDA.
Round 2 standalone independent re-reader recomputes split isolation, dev selection, all test selections/regret/bootstrap/Holm and training summaries without importing implementation modules.
Round 3 clean-process tests, deterministic hash/one-evaluation audit, local aggregate export and forbidden per-sequence/raw-file scan.
local_export: De-identified aggregates, configs, code, logs, training curves and verification only; no sequence strings, per-sequence labels or predictions, .npy/.npz/.pt, raw data or test selection indices.
